title: oenothera cheiranthifolia subsp. suffruticosa
intro: Oenothera cheiranthifolia subsp. suffruticosa, commonly known as a type of evening primrose, is a plant species belonging to the Onagraceae family. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to provide relief from various health issues, including inflammation, anxiety, and insomnia, due to its numerous health benefits. The plant's therapeutic actions include acting as an anti-inflammatory, sedative, and anxiolytic, which can help in managing symptoms associated with stress, anxiety disorders, and sleep disorders. The bioactive constituents present in Oenothera cheiranthifolia subsp. suffruticosa include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
